svg.text: Windows environment setup — CUMUL WFP project
Full isolation strategy — existing projects remain untouched
Layer 1 — system-wide prerequisites (install once, shared across all projects)
system-level, installs driver
Layer 2 — Python virtual environment (fully isolated, other projects unaffected)
cumul_venv\ (python -m venv cumul_venv)
Layer 3 — packet capture: tcpdump does not run on Windows — use this instead

g.text: Pure Python, uses Npcap, runs in venv

svg.text: tcpdump is Linux/macOS only. Scapy with Npcap is the direct Windows equivalent — same packet-level access, same filter syntax.
Layer 4 — Tor Browser Bundle configuration for Stem control
Isolation guarantee — what is and is not touched on your existing system

g.text: Windows PATH (if Python was added cleanly)
Admin rights needed for Npcap install only

svg.text: Step-by-step setup sequence (ordered to avoid conflicts)
Verify Python 3.8 is installed
python --version in cmd. If missing: download python.org/downloads/release/python-3812 (add to PATH)
Check for WinPcap conflict
Control Panel → Programs. If WinPcap is listed, uninstall it before Npcap to avoid driver conflict.
Install Npcap (run as Administrator)
npcap.com → installer. Check "WinPcap API compatibility". Reboot not required but recommended.
Download Tor Browser Bundle (portable)
torproject.org → Windows .exe installer → extract to D:\tools\tor-browser (no system install)
Edit torrc to enable ControlPort
D:\tools\tor-browser\Browser\TorBrowser\Data\Tor\torrc → add 3 lines shown in Layer 4 above
Create the project virtual environment
cd D:\projects\cumul_wfp then: python -m venv cumul_venv then: cumul_venv\Scripts\activate
Install all Python dependencies inside venv
pip install scapy stem selenium scikit-learn numpy scipy matplotlib joblib pywin32
Download geckodriver and set path
github.com/mozilla/geckodriver → place geckodriver.exe in D:\tools\ → add to PATH or pass path in config.py
Run smoke test
python tests\smoke_test.py — verifies Npcap, Tor connection, Stem signal, Scapy capture in ~30 sec
Known Windows-specific gotchas and mitigations
Scapy needs Admin for raw capture
Run VS Code / terminal as Administrator when capturing. Normal user for all other steps.
Interface name is not "eth0"
Use scapy.arch.get_if_list() to find the correct adapter name, store in config.py.
Tor ControlPort auth on Windows
Use CookieAuthentication 1 in torrc. Stem reads cookie file automatically — no plaintext password.
Selenium + TBB on Windows
Use firefox_binary= pointing to TBB\Browser\firefox.exe. Set profile to TBB profile dir.
LIBSVM vs scikit-learn
Use scikit-learn SVC (wraps libsvm internally). No separate LIBSVM binary needed on Windows.
Antivirus false positives
Whitelist D:\projects\cumul_wfp\ and D:\tools\tor-browser\ in Windows Defender before running.
requirements.txt for reproducibility
pip freeze > requirements.txt after setup. Other devs: pip install -r requirements.txt in their own venv.
Summary: 2 system installs (Npcap + TBB portable) + 1 venv. Nothing else touches your machine.
